plan.name: Independent loss-stream confirmation of frozen service detector

hypothesis.detector: Every registered affected B path alarms strictly before 100 ms in at least 95% of trials, separately per primary condition.
hypothesis.policy: With identical inputs, observable benefit gating avoids costly replacements while retaining completion under persistent faults.

scoring.unit: all affected paths within a trial
scoring.confidence: 95% one-sided exact binomial, per condition; no familywise correction
scoring.parameter_source: Frozen mirrored defaults; native consistency checked by independent replay
scoring.scope: 16 GPUs, fixed dual-plane topology and registered traffic/fault distributions; not general grey-fault coverage
scoring.seed_formula: seed_base + trial * seed_stride; node/onset from Random(seed)

supplement.reason: Inherited injector uses seed+node; adjacent scene seeds can reuse loss streams.
supplement.unchanged: Native implementation, detector parameters, policy and workload.
supplement.interpretation: Separate prospective confirmation; never pool with reference loss detection counts.
